title: fix(i18n): fill all missing and fake translations for 8 languages
body:
## Summary

- **Zero missing keys** across all 8 non-English locales (ja, de, es, fr, ko, pt, ru, ar) — all 1528/1528 keys covered in every language
- Fixed all fake/copy-pasted English translations so language switching now actually changes displayed text
- Covers every recently-added section that was never propagated to non-English locales

## What was translated

| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| `gantt` | Column names, toolbar (zoom, period nav, task list toggle) |
| `grid` | Density toolbar, full CSV import wizard (all steps, templates, error messages) |
| `list` / `kanban` / `view` | Pull-to-refresh, share/print, group settings, view management |
| `detail` | Concurrent-edit conflict UI, approval lock/cancel, link copy, activity/history |
| `dashboard` | Trend comparison labels (vs. last month/quarter/year) |
| `report` | Matrix editor (field picker, groupings, aggregates, chart types) |
| `appDesigner` | Full app-builder wizard, nav-builder, widget/component editors, branding editor, object manager, field designer |
| `console` | Object-view creation dialog, all view-type descriptions, chart/map/gantt helpers, sharing & accessibility options |
| `auth` | `resetPassword`, `verifyEmail`, `setup`, `device`, `shell` sections |
| `sidebar` / `home` / `layout` | Greetings, stats, app-switcher, activity feed, metadata inspector |
| `search` / `empty` / `renderer` | Search UI, not-found pages, renderer labels |
| `actionDialog` / `rowAction` / `navigationSync` | Action dialogs, row menus, nav-sync toasts |
| `publicForm` | Full form UI + demo contact/support forms with all fields |
| `marketplace` | Full marketplace UI, install/uninstall dialogs, categories, pricing tiers |

## Notes on remaining "fake" matches

The audit still flags ~15–77 keys per language as English-identical. These are **correct** — the target language genuinely uses the same word: `Dashboard`, `System`, `Kanban`, `Gantt`, `Webhook`, `JSON`, `CRM`, `ERP`, `AI`, `URL`, `OK`, `"—"`, `"v{{version}}"`, `Status`, `Signal`, `Timer`, `Navigation`, `Layout`, `Branding`, etc.

## Test plan

- [ ] Switch UI language to each of ja / de / es / fr / ko / pt / ru / ar and verify text is no longer English in the main sections
- [ ] Open the App Designer wizard and confirm all steps render in the selected language
- [ ] Open the CSV import dialog (grid view) and verify all step labels and field names are translated
- [ ] Check the public form page for translated submit/thank-you messages
- [ ] Verify marketplace page text is translated
